text: Her slender form, with a navel bent in reverence, shone as she entered the darkened chamber, her new hair like a fresh wave. Her lower garment, surpassing the white of the other, glowed like the middle of a belt, as if adorned with a lustrous ornament. The young girl, bearing a beautiful triple garland, stood in the center, her heart detached from the middle, as if a staircase had been prepared for the ascent of new youth by desire. The two breasts of the woman with lotus-like eyes, pressed against each other, were pale and enlarged; in the middle, as if the dark-faced one’s thread of lotus stems could not be found, they were intertwined.
